# Source Code of the `ggpcp` Additions {#sec-appendix-code}

This appendix reproduces `pcp_spread_ties.R` exactly as it stands in the repository (`Updated numerical ties/pcp_spread_ties.R`).
It defines the numerical tie-breaking step `pcp_spread_ties()` and its alias `tie_spread()`, the combined wrapper `pcp_arrange_unified()`, and the annotation functions `pcp_tie_boxes()` and `geom_pcp_tieboxes()`, together with the internal helpers they rely on.
Equation and section numbers in the comments refer to the research proposal.
